description: This file defines an abstract base class for audio filters used in input transportation pipelines. It specifies methods for starting, stopping, processing control frames, and filtering audio data, serving as a common interface for concrete filter implementations.

classes.name: BaseAudioFilter
classes.description: Abstract base class for input transport audio filters, defining the interface for starting, stopping, configuring, and filtering audio data.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Initialize the filter when the input transport starts, with the provided sample rate.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Clean up the filter when the input transport stops.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: FilterControlFrame)
methods.description: Process control frames for runtime configuration of the filter.

methods.name: bytes filter(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Apply the audio filter to the input audio data and return the filtered audio.

ctags.name: filter
ctags.pattern: /^    async def filter(self, audio: bytes) -> bytes:$/
